description: Regueiro-Picallo, Manuel at Universidade da Coruña publishes controlled observations for inferring gully-pot sediment deposits from temperature signals through Co-UDlabs. The campaign examines heat transfer between water and deposited sediment to test whether temperature differences can indicate sediment thickness or presence. It is a separate gully-pot experiment within the broader Co-UDlabs thermal-monitoring programme. Coverage is the Deltares experimental campaign in the Netherlands; measurement dates, exact time step and tested sediment depths are unspecified. Zenodo provides a data ZIP and a PDF storage report with free access under CC BY-NC 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is temperature is an indirect sediment indicator, and the native description does not supply the calibration coefficients or full uncertainty model. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
